style: mom types the log the way she talks into her phone: run-on, 'so like', 'anyway', asides in parentheses, little punctuation

situations.name: Parents going out for the evening while Lucia stays home with her younger brother
situations.feared_outcome: Something will happen to you on the drive and I'll be the one who has to deal with it

behaviors.text: Texts 'where r u' over and over and keeps checking the location-sharing app
Has mom call her the moment they leave the restaurant

accommodations.text: Mom keeps location sharing on and answers every text right away

situations.name: Staying the weekend at her grandparents' while parents are away
situations.feared_outcome: You won't come back and I'll be stuck there

behaviors.text: Went to her grandparents' on Friday, then texted Saturday afternoon that she felt sick and wanted to be picked up
FaceTimes mom at night and keeps the call going until she falls asleep

accommodations.text: Mom drove 50 minutes back to pick her up early
Mom stays on FaceTime until Lucia is asleep

behaviors.text: Stayed up very late on her phone the nights dad was away; mom isn't sure it's about dad
Sleeps in her parents' room on dad's side while he's away

accommodations.text: Mom lets her sleep in the parents' bed while dad is away

situations.name: Coming home to an empty house after school
situations.feared_outcome: Someone will come to the house and I'll be by myself

behaviors.text: Goes to a friend's house or the public library instead of coming home when nobody is there
Calls mom on speaker as she walks in and keeps her on the line until mom gets home

accommodations.text: Mom leaves work early on Tuesdays so Lucia isn't home alone
Mom stays on the phone with her, sometimes for an hour, until she gets home

monitoring_log.situation: so we went to the steakhouse for my sister's bday and lucia stayed home with her brother
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: so like she was texting where r u where r u the whole time and she had my location up on her phone (her brother told me after) and she made me promise to call the second we left
monitoring_log.parent_response: answered every text pretty much right away, called when we walked out, we were home by 9 like always

monitoring_log.situation: weekend at mom and dad's (my parents) while we went to the wedding
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: friday was ok-ish she facetimed me at like 10:30 and wanted me to stay on till she fell asleep. then saturday around 2 she texts me she feels sick and can i come get her. she wasnt sick she had a granola bar and was fine in the car
monitoring_log.parent_response: stayed on facetime friday till she was out. saturday i left the wedding lunch and drove the 50 min back and got her, anyway my husband stayed for the reception

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: went to priya's again instead of home, texted me she'd be there til i got back
monitoring_log.parent_response: said ok, picked her up there on my way

monitoring_log.situation: after school, tues (i leave early tuesdays now)
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: got home before me by like 10 min and called me on speaker walking in, kept me on
monitoring_log.parent_response: stayed on with her the whole drive (on other days its sometimes like an hour on the phone), honestly i left at 3 on tues so she wouldnt be alone very long

monitoring_log.parent_words: so jorge is in phoenix til sunday and she's been up so late on her phone like 1am and i honestly dont know if thats about him being gone or just being 14 and also she asked to sleep in our room on his side and i said fine

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: public library till 5 then walked home when she saw on location i was home. she said somebody could come to the door when shes there by herself
monitoring_log.parent_response: didnt say anything about it, made dinner

monitoring_log.situation: date night w jorge, just dinner
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: where r u texts like every 20 min, and at 8:15 she texted what if you get in an accident and i'm the one who has to deal with it like with the police and everything
monitoring_log.parent_response: texted back every time, said we're fine we're leaving soon, home by 9 again
